data.name: N0ISE 3.5mm Wired Earphone with Powerful HD Mic for Clear Sound, in-Line Volume Controller & Noise Cancellation Compatib
data.description: Experience immersive audio with these high-performance 3.5mm wired earphones — engineered for rich bass, detailed mids, and crisp highs. Whether you’re listening to your favorite playlist, attending online meetings, or gaming, these earphones deliver powerful, balanced sound. The built-in microphone and multi-function button let you take calls hands-free and control music effortlessly. With a tangle-free cable and ergonomic silicone ear tips, they’re ideal for daily use — from the gym to your commute. Compatible with: All smartphones, laptops, tablets, and devices with a 3.5mm headphone jack (Android, i Phone with adapter, Windows, etc.)
